metric_definitions.matching_policy: Greedy 1-to-1 bipartite matching based on IoU >= 0.50 (or >= 0.30 threshold). Duplicate predictions on same GT are marked False Positives.
metric_definitions.true_positives_tp: Number of GT objects correctly matched to a candidate prediction with IoU >= 0.30.
metric_definitions.false_positives_fp: Number of predictions with no matching GT object or IoU < 0.30.
metric_definitions.false_negatives_fn: Number of GT objects with no matching candidate prediction.
metric_definitions.map50_formula: Mean Average Precision over all 11 UI classes at IoU = 0.50 threshold.
